title: Every AI in one place: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, free and local · {name}
description: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, a free AI and one on your computer, in one browser tab. Switch mid-task and keep the history. Free, open source, no new subscription.
h1: Every AI in one place, nothing lost when you switch, and not one more subscription.
lede: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, a free AI or one that runs on your own computer: use them from one browser tab, and change in the middle of a task. Your history stays with you, on your device, whichever AI answers.

Switch to an AI online and it reads the task so far, as it must to carry on.
sale.title: {name} has nothing to sell you.
sale.why: It is free and open source. What you pay goes to the AI you choose, and only if you choose one that costs.
sale.items: There is none for people: no paid version, no trial that ends.
Your plan and your keys are billed by their makers, at their price. {name} adds nothing.
sale.source: Open source, under MIT: what is free today can’t be taken back. Free for you, paid for by organisations: {pricing}.
turn.body: Start with a free AI. Add yours when you like.
turn.other: Already pay for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot? {plan}.
faq.items: Can I ask several AIs at once?
Not side by side: one AI answers at a time. Switch from the box and ask again, and both answers stay in the task.
Is there one subscription for all of them?
{name} sells none. It uses the plan you already pay for, a key billed by what you use, or an AI that costs nothing.
It depends on the task, and it changes often. Leave the chip on {auto}, or pick one by hand and switch when an answer disappoints: the task carries on.
Yes, under the MIT licence. Anyone can read every line, and host a copy at their own address.
A key you type is kept on your devices, sealed. It goes only to the service it belongs to, and never into a backup or a share.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes, in the browser, with a free AI or your key. Your plan and the AI on this computer need a computer.
